why_similar_en: Both are farming and life-simulation RPGs built around developing a farm, forming relationships and helping a town recover.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是围绕经营农场、发展人际关系和帮助城镇复兴展开的农场生活模拟 RPG。
key_differences_en: Fields of Mistria is a single-player pixel-art fantasy with magic; Coral Island uses 3D tropical settings and supports online co-op.
key_differences_zh: 《Fields of Mistria》是带魔法元素的单人像素风作品；《Coral Island》采用 3D 热带海岛场景，并支持在线合作。
best_for_en: Choose Coral Island for cooperative island life; choose Fields of Mistria for a solo, pixel-art fantasy routine.
best_for_zh: 想和朋友经营海岛可选《Coral Island》；偏好单人像素幻想生活可选《Fields of Mistria》。

why_similar_en: Both combine farming, town relationships, resource gathering and optional co-op in a long-running life-simulation loop.
why_similar_zh: 两者都把农场经营、城镇关系、资源收集和可选合作模式组合成长线生活模拟循环。
key_differences_en: Stardew Valley uses pixel art and a valley setting; Coral Island uses 3D tropical environments and adds ocean diving and reef restoration.
key_differences_zh: 《Stardew Valley》采用像素画面和山谷小镇；《Coral Island》采用 3D 热带环境，并加入潜水和珊瑚礁修复。
best_for_en: Choose Coral Island for a tropical 3D setting and ocean activities; choose Stardew Valley for its pixel-art presentation.
best_for_zh: 想要热带 3D 场景和海洋活动可选《Coral Island》；偏好像素画面可选《Stardew Valley》。

why_similar_en: Both are Larian party-based RPGs with turn-based combat, consequential choices and cooperative play.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是拉瑞安制作的队伍制 RPG，包含回合制战斗、会影响剧情的选择和合作游玩。
key_differences_en: Baldur's Gate 3 is based on Dungeons & Dragons rules and its setting; Divinity: Original Sin 2 uses Larian's own rules and places more emphasis on elemental surface interactions.
key_differences_zh: 《Baldur's Gate 3》采用《龙与地下城》规则与世界观；《Divinity: Original Sin 2》使用拉瑞安自有规则，并更强调元素地表互动。
best_for_en: Choose Divinity: Original Sin 2 to explore Larian's original combat system; choose Baldur's Gate 3 for a D&D-based adventure.
best_for_zh: 想体验拉瑞安自有战斗系统可选《Divinity: Original Sin 2》；想玩基于 D&D 的冒险可选《Baldur's Gate 3》。

why_similar_en: Both are Hazelight co-op adventures designed for two players and built around frequently changing cooperative mechanics.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是 Hazelight 为双人合作设计的冒险游戏，并会不断切换合作机制。
key_differences_en: It Takes Two follows a couple through a family story; Split Fiction moves between science-fiction and fantasy worlds created by two writers.
key_differences_zh: 《It Takes Two》围绕一对夫妻和家庭故事展开；《Split Fiction》让两位作家在科幻与奇幻世界之间穿梭。
best_for_en: Choose Split Fiction for science-fiction and fantasy genre shifts; choose It Takes Two for its family-centered story.
best_for_zh: 喜欢科幻与奇幻题材切换可选《Split Fiction》；更在意家庭主题故事可选《It Takes Two》。

why_similar_en: Both are free-to-play, team-based hero shooters with distinct character abilities and objective-focused matches.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是免费游玩的团队英雄射击游戏，角色拥有不同能力，对局围绕团队目标展开。
key_differences_en: Marvel Rivals uses Marvel characters, team-up abilities and destructible battlefields; Overwatch uses Blizzard's original hero roster and supports 5v5 and 6v6 modes.
key_differences_zh: 《Marvel Rivals》采用漫威角色、组合技能和可破坏战场；《Overwatch》使用暴雪原创英雄，并提供 5v5 与 6v6 模式。
best_for_en: Choose Marvel Rivals for Marvel characters and team-up mechanics; choose Overwatch for its established original hero roster.
best_for_zh: 喜欢漫威角色和组合技能可选《Marvel Rivals》；偏好成熟的原创英雄阵容可选《Overwatch》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player first-person survival-horror games in which the player investigates a hostile place without conventional combat tools.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人第一人称生存恐怖游戏，玩家需要在缺少常规战斗手段的情况下调查危险地点。
key_differences_en: Outlast is set mainly in Mount Massive Asylum; Outlast 2 moves to the isolated settlement of Temple Gate and follows a different cast.
key_differences_zh: 《Outlast》主要发生在巨山精神病院；《Outlast 2》转向与世隔绝的 Temple Gate，并采用不同角色。
best_for_en: Choose Outlast 2 for an outdoor cult setting; start with Outlast for the asylum story that introduced the series.
best_for_zh: 想体验户外邪教聚落可选《Outlast 2》；想从系列起点的精神病院故事开始则选《Outlast》。

why_similar_en: Both combine farming, relationships, crafting and cooperative play in a town-based life-simulation RPG.
why_similar_zh: 两者都在城镇生活模拟 RPG 中结合农场经营、人际关系、制作和合作游玩。
key_differences_en: Sun Haven adds a skill tree, magic, monsters, dragons and multiplayer for up to eight people; Stardew Valley keeps a more grounded rural setting.
key_differences_zh: 《Sun Haven》加入技能树、魔法、怪物、龙和最多八人联机；《Stardew Valley》的乡村设定更朴素。
best_for_en: Choose Sun Haven for stronger fantasy and character progression; choose Stardew Valley for a more grounded farm-town routine.
best_for_zh: 想要更强的奇幻元素和角色成长可选《Sun Haven》；偏好朴素农场小镇生活可选《Stardew Valley》。

target_title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition
why_similar_en: Both are story-rich, party-based fantasy RPGs in which character builds and player choices shape a long campaign.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是重剧情的队伍制奇幻 RPG，角色构筑和玩家选择会影响长篇战役。
key_differences_en: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous is single-player and centers on Pathfinder rules and Mythic progression; Baldur's Gate 3 uses D&D rules and supports co-op.
key_differences_zh: 《Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous》是单人游戏，核心是 Pathfinder 规则和神话成长；《Baldur's Gate 3》采用 D&D 规则并支持合作。
best_for_en: Choose Pathfinder for denser character-building and Mythic progression; choose Baldur's Gate 3 for cooperative D&D role-playing.
best_for_zh: 想要更密集的角色构筑和神话成长可选《Pathfinder》；想合作体验 D&D 角色扮演可选《Baldur's Gate 3》。

why_similar_en: Both are relaxed farming RPGs with co-op, relationships and a community that develops alongside the player's farm.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是轻松的农场 RPG，支持合作、关系培养，并让社区随着玩家的农场一同发展。
key_differences_en: Roots of Pacha uses pixel art and a Stone Age setting where discoveries help the clan; Coral Island uses a modern 3D tropical island and reef restoration.
key_differences_zh: 《Roots of Pacha》采用像素画面和石器时代设定，发现会推动氏族发展；《Coral Island》采用现代 3D 热带海岛和珊瑚礁修复主题。
best_for_en: Choose Roots of Pacha for prehistoric community development; choose Coral Island for tropical island life and ocean activities.
best_for_zh: 喜欢史前社区发展可选《Roots of Pacha》；喜欢热带海岛生活和海洋活动可选《Coral Island》。

why_similar_en: Both place Cadence and the NecroDancer setting inside rhythm combat where enemy patterns must be read on the beat.
why_similar_zh: 两者都以 Cadence 和 NecroDancer 世界为背景，战斗要求玩家按节拍识别敌人模式。
key_differences_en: Crypt of the NecroDancer is a rhythm roguelike played on dungeon grids; Rift of the NecroDancer uses lane-based rhythm battles and is not structured as a dungeon roguelike.
key_differences_zh: 《Crypt of the NecroDancer》是网格地牢式节奏 Roguelike；《Rift of the NecroDancer》采用轨道式节奏战斗，不再以地牢 Roguelike 为结构。
best_for_en: Choose Rift for lane-based rhythm challenges; choose Crypt for dungeon exploration and roguelike runs.
best_for_zh: 喜欢轨道式节奏挑战可选《Rift》；喜欢地牢探索和 Roguelike 流程可选《Crypt》。

why_similar_en: Both focus on designing automated production lines, moving materials by conveyor and expanding factories to produce more complex items.
why_similar_zh: 两者都以设计自动化产线、用传送带运输物料和扩建工厂生产更复杂物品为核心。
key_differences_en: Factorio is viewed from above in a 2D world and includes base defense; Satisfactory is first-person, supports multi-story factories and places more emphasis on open-world exploration.
key_differences_zh: 《Factorio》采用俯视 2D 世界并包含基地防御；《Satisfactory》是第一人称，支持多层工厂，并更强调开放世界探索。
best_for_en: Choose Satisfactory to build and explore from inside a 3D factory; choose Factorio for top-down logistics and defense.
best_for_zh: 想在 3D 工厂内部建造和探索可选《Satisfactory》；喜欢俯视物流规划与防御可选《Factorio》。

why_similar_en: Both are cooperative horror games for up to four players that ask a team to identify a supernatural threat using investigative equipment.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是最多四人合作的恐怖游戏，队伍需要使用调查设备识别超自然威胁。
key_differences_en: Demonologist explicitly includes an exorcism objective after identification; Phasmophobia focuses on gathering evidence and identifying the ghost type.
key_differences_zh: 《Demonologist》在识别恶灵后还包含驱魔目标；《Phasmophobia》主要聚焦收集证据和判断鬼魂类型。
best_for_en: Choose Demonologist if completing an exorcism is important; choose Phasmophobia for an evidence-focused ghost investigation.
best_for_zh: 在意完成驱魔仪式可选《Demonologist》；偏好以证据为核心的鬼魂调查可选《Phasmophobia》。

target_title: The Case of the Golden Idol
why_similar_en: Both are single-player deduction games that present deaths as evidence puzzles and ask the player to identify people, events and motives.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人推理游戏，把死亡现场作为证据谜题，让玩家判断人物、事件和动机。
key_differences_en: Return of the Obra Dinn reconstructs events aboard a missing ship through first-person scenes; The Case of the Golden Idol uses static scenes across a connected murder conspiracy.
key_differences_zh: 《Return of the Obra Dinn》通过第一人称场景还原失踪船只上的事件；《The Case of the Golden Idol》使用静态场景串联谋杀阴谋。
best_for_en: Choose Golden Idol for scene-by-scene conspiracy deduction; choose Obra Dinn for investigating one ship and reconstructing its crew's fate.
best_for_zh: 喜欢逐场景拆解阴谋可选《Golden Idol》；想围绕一艘船重建全体船员命运可选《Obra Dinn》。

target_title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
why_similar_en: Both are single-player open-world fantasy RPGs built around exploration, quests and character progression.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是围绕探索、任务和角色成长展开的单人开放世界奇幻 RPG。
key_differences_en: The Witcher 3 follows the defined character and story of Geralt; Skyrim lets the player create a character and provides Steam Workshop mod support.
key_differences_zh: 《The Witcher 3》围绕固定主角 Geralt 和他的故事展开；《Skyrim》允许玩家自建角色，并提供 Steam Workshop 模组支持。
best_for_en: Choose Skyrim for character creation and mod-supported exploration; choose The Witcher 3 for a defined protagonist and authored narrative.
best_for_zh: 想自建角色并使用模组探索可选《Skyrim》；偏好固定主角和作者化叙事可选《The Witcher 3》。

why_similar_en: Both are open-world tactical RPGs about recruiting, equipping and leading a mercenary company through contracts.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是开放世界战术 RPG，玩家需要招募、装备并带领佣兵团完成合同。
key_differences_en: Battle Brothers uses a procedurally generated single-player campaign; Wartales presents a large medieval world and supports online co-op.
key_differences_zh: 《Battle Brothers》采用程序生成的单人战役；《Wartales》提供大型中世纪世界并支持在线合作。
best_for_en: Choose Wartales for a cooperative mercenary campaign; choose Battle Brothers for a procedurally generated solo company run.
best_for_zh: 想合作经营佣兵团可选《Wartales》；偏好程序生成的单人佣兵战役可选《Battle Brothers》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player action-platformers about the Penitent One confronting the Miracle through exploration and demanding combat.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是围绕 Penitent One 对抗 Miracle 展开的单人动作平台游戏，核心包含探索和高要求战斗。
key_differences_en: Blasphemous 2 continues the story in a new world and expands weapon choice and traversal abilities; the first game introduces Cvstodia and the original pilgrimage.
key_differences_zh: 《Blasphemous 2》在新世界延续故事，并扩展武器选择和移动能力；初代负责介绍 Cvstodia 和最初的朝圣旅程。
best_for_en: Start with Blasphemous for the original setting and story; choose Blasphemous 2 after that for expanded combat and traversal options.
best_for_zh: 想了解最初世界观和故事应先玩《Blasphemous》；之后可选《Blasphemous 2》体验扩展后的战斗与移动。

why_similar_en: Both are farming and life-simulation RPGs with relationships, crafting and online co-op.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是包含关系培养、制作和在线合作的农场生活模拟 RPG。
key_differences_en: Coral Island uses a tropical island and ocean-restoration theme; Sun Haven uses fantasy towns, magic, monsters, skill trees and multiplayer for up to eight people.
key_differences_zh: 《Coral Island》采用热带海岛和海洋修复主题；《Sun Haven》包含奇幻城镇、魔法、怪物、技能树和最多八人联机。
best_for_en: Choose Coral Island for tropical community and ocean activities; choose Sun Haven for fantasy progression and larger co-op groups.
best_for_zh: 喜欢热带社区和海洋活动可选《Coral Island》；想要奇幻成长和更大合作队伍可选《Sun Haven》。

target_title: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
why_similar_en: Both are single-player tactical stealth games from Mimimi in which a small team combines specialist abilities to infiltrate guarded areas.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是 Mimimi 制作的单人战术潜行游戏，玩家需要组合小队成员的专长潜入守卫区域。
key_differences_en: Desperados III uses a Wild West setting; Shadow Tactics is set in Edo-period Japan and follows five specialists serving a shogun.
key_differences_zh: 《Desperados III》采用美国西部背景；《Shadow Tactics》发生在江户时代日本，围绕为幕府服务的五名专家展开。
best_for_en: Choose by setting: Wild West tactics in Desperados III or Edo-period infiltration in Shadow Tactics.
best_for_zh: 可按题材选择：《Desperados III》是西部战术潜行，《Shadow Tactics》是江户时代渗透行动。

why_similar_en: Both are Korean rhythm games on Steam with large song libraries, multiple key modes and online multiplayer.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是登陆 Steam 的韩国节奏游戏，拥有大量曲目、多种按键模式和在线多人玩法。
key_differences_en: DJMAX Respect V combines new modes with tracks from the DJMAX series and guest artists; EZ2ON Reboot:R remasters music and visuals from the EZ2DJ/EZ2ON catalogue while adding new songs.
key_differences_zh: 《DJMAX Respect V》把 DJMAX 系列曲目、嘉宾音乐人和新模式结合；《EZ2ON Reboot:R》重制 EZ2DJ/EZ2ON 曲库的音乐与画面，同时加入新歌。
best_for_en: Choose based on the song catalogue and chart style you prefer; both support competitive online play.
best_for_zh: 可根据更喜欢的曲库和谱面风格选择；两者都支持在线竞技。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player, hand-crafted adventures from Nomada Studio that use visual storytelling and changing environments to carry an emotional journey.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是 Nomada Studio 制作的单人手工美术冒险，通过视觉叙事和环境变化承载情感旅程。
key_differences_en: GRIS follows a young woman processing sorrow through platforming and new abilities; Neva follows a woman and a wolf across a dying world and includes more direct action combat.
key_differences_zh: 《GRIS》讲述少女通过平台跳跃和新能力面对悲伤；《Neva》讲述女性与狼穿越衰败世界，并包含更直接的动作战斗。
best_for_en: Choose GRIS for a quieter platforming journey; choose Neva for a companion story with more combat.
best_for_zh: 喜欢更安静的平台冒险可选《GRIS》；想要同伴故事和更多战斗可选《Neva》。

target_title: The Walking Dead: The Final Season
why_similar_en: Both are single-player narrative adventures in Telltale's Walking Dead series where dialogue and player choices shape relationships and survival.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是 Telltale《The Walking Dead》系列的单人叙事冒险，对话和玩家选择会影响关系与生存。
key_differences_en: The first season follows Lee and Clementine near the start of the outbreak; The Final Season centers on the older Clementine protecting AJ and seeking a home.
key_differences_zh: 第一季围绕疫情初期的 Lee 与 Clementine 展开；最终季聚焦长大后的 Clementine 保护 AJ 并寻找家园。
best_for_en: Play the first season to begin Clementine's story; play The Final Season after the preceding seasons to complete it.
best_for_zh: 想从头了解 Clementine 的故事应先玩第一季；完成前面各季后再玩最终季收尾。

why_similar_en: Both are choice-driven cinematic horror games from Supermassive Games where a group can live or die according to player decisions.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是 Supermassive Games 制作的选择驱动电影化恐怖游戏，角色是否生还取决于玩家决定。
key_differences_en: Until Dawn is a single-player story set around a mountain lodge; The Quarry follows nine summer-camp counselors and includes shared-screen group play alongside multiplayer options.
key_differences_zh: 《Until Dawn》是围绕山间小屋展开的单人故事；《The Quarry》讲述九名夏令营辅导员，并在多人玩法之外支持同屏群体游玩。
best_for_en: Choose The Quarry for a group movie-night format; choose Until Dawn for a focused single-player slasher story.
best_for_zh: 想多人一起体验电影之夜可选《The Quarry》；想专注单人砍杀片式故事可选《Until Dawn》。

why_similar_en: Both are island life-simulation games with farming, gathering, town development and cooperative play.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是海岛生活模拟游戏，包含种植、采集、城镇发展和合作游玩。
key_differences_en: Coral Island begins with an established community and emphasizes relationships and reef restoration; Dinkum asks the player to expand a settlement in an Australian-outback-inspired survival setting.
key_differences_zh: 《Coral Island》从已有社区起步，更强调人际关系和珊瑚礁修复；《Dinkum》让玩家在受澳洲内陆启发的生存环境中扩建聚落。
best_for_en: Choose Coral Island for a relationship-rich tropical town; choose Dinkum for settlement building and survival gathering.
best_for_zh: 喜欢关系丰富的热带城镇可选《Coral Island》；喜欢聚落建设和生存采集可选《Dinkum》。

why_similar_en: Both are factory-automation games about designing production lines, moving resources and scaling an industrial system.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是工厂自动化游戏，核心是设计产线、运输资源和扩张工业系统。
key_differences_en: Factorio builds across a 2D planetary surface and includes hostile creatures; Dyson Sphere Program expands production across planets and star systems toward a Dyson sphere.
key_differences_zh: 《Factorio》在 2D 行星表面建设并包含敌对生物；《Dyson Sphere Program》把生产扩展到多颗行星和恒星系，目标是建造戴森球。
best_for_en: Choose Dyson Sphere Program for interplanetary logistics; choose Factorio for dense 2D factory planning and defense.
best_for_zh: 喜欢跨行星物流可选《Dyson Sphere Program》；喜欢密集的 2D 工厂规划和防御可选《Factorio》。

why_similar_en: Both are pixel-art farming RPGs that combine town relationships with magic, exploration and combat.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是像素风农场 RPG，把城镇关系与魔法、探索和战斗结合。
key_differences_en: Fields of Mistria is single-player; Sun Haven supports online co-op for up to eight people and adds multiple fantasy towns and skill-tree progression.
key_differences_zh: 《Fields of Mistria》是单人游戏；《Sun Haven》支持最多八人在线合作，并加入多个奇幻城镇和技能树成长。
best_for_en: Choose Sun Haven for multiplayer and broader fantasy progression; choose Fields of Mistria for a solo farm-life adventure.
best_for_zh: 想要多人联机和更广的奇幻成长可选《Sun Haven》；偏好单人农场生活冒险可选《Fields of Mistria》。

target_title: Ori and the Blind Forest: Definitive Edition
why_similar_en: Both are single-player, visually distinctive 2D action-platformers built around exploring a large fantasy world and unlocking movement abilities.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是视觉风格鲜明的单人 2D 动作平台游戏，核心是探索大型奇幻世界并解锁移动能力。
key_differences_en: Silksong emphasizes combat and ascent through a haunted kingdom; Ori and the Blind Forest places more emphasis on movement, escape sequences and Ori's story.
key_differences_zh: 《Silksong》更强调战斗和向上探索被诅咒的王国；《Ori and the Blind Forest》更强调移动、逃生段落和 Ori 的故事。
best_for_en: Choose Ori for movement-led platforming and a compact story; choose Silksong for more combat-focused exploration.
best_for_zh: 喜欢以移动为主的平台挑战和紧凑故事可选《Ori》；想要更偏战斗的探索可选《Silksong》。

why_similar_en: Both are Need for Speed street-racing games built around customized cars, police pressure and a mix of daytime and nighttime competition.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是《Need for Speed》街头赛车游戏，核心包含改装车辆、警察追捕以及白天与夜晚的竞赛。
key_differences_en: Heat separates sanctioned daytime events from higher-risk night racing; Unbound uses weekly qualifiers and a graffiti-influenced visual style.
key_differences_zh: 《Heat》把正规白天赛事与高风险夜间比赛分开；《Unbound》采用每周资格赛结构和受涂鸦影响的视觉风格。
best_for_en: Choose Heat for its day-and-night progression structure; choose Unbound for its qualifier format and stylized presentation.
best_for_zh: 喜欢昼夜分段成长可选《Heat》；喜欢资格赛结构和风格化表现可选《Unbound》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player first-person survival-horror games centered on exploration, hiding and escaping rather than conventional armed combat.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人第一人称生存恐怖游戏，重点是探索、躲藏和逃生，而不是常规武装战斗。
key_differences_en: Outlast follows a journalist using a camera in an asylum; Amnesia explores a castle with physics puzzles, a lantern and a sanity system.
key_differences_zh: 《Outlast》让记者带着摄像机调查精神病院；《Amnesia》在城堡中加入物理解谜、提灯和理智系统。
best_for_en: Choose Outlast for pursuit-heavy found-footage horror; choose Amnesia for slower exploration and environmental puzzles.
best_for_zh: 喜欢追逐感强的伪纪录片恐怖可选《Outlast》；喜欢较慢探索和环境谜题可选《Amnesia》。

why_similar_en: Both are free-to-play team shooters in which players choose characters or classes with distinct tactical roles.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是免费团队射击游戏，玩家需要选择拥有不同战术职责的角色或职业。
key_differences_en: Team Fortress 2 is organized around nine classes and community-created content; Overwatch uses a larger hero roster with ability kits and 5v5 or 6v6 modes.
key_differences_zh: 《Team Fortress 2》围绕九个职业和社区创作内容展开；《Overwatch》使用更大的英雄阵容、成套技能以及 5v5 或 6v6 模式。
best_for_en: Choose Team Fortress 2 for its class-based format and Workshop ecosystem; choose Overwatch for hero abilities and current objective modes.
best_for_zh: 喜欢职业制和 Workshop 生态可选《Team Fortress 2》；喜欢英雄技能和现行目标模式可选《Overwatch》。

why_similar_en: Both are cooperative survival-action games that combine exploration, crafting, base building and boss progression in a fantasy world.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是合作生存动作游戏，在奇幻世界中结合探索、制作、基地建设和首领推进。
key_differences_en: Valheim uses a procedurally generated Viking-inspired world for up to ten players; Enshrouded uses a corrupted-fog fantasy kingdom, character skill progression and co-op for up to sixteen.
key_differences_zh: 《Valheim》采用程序生成的维京风世界，最多十人；《Enshrouded》采用被迷雾侵蚀的奇幻王国、角色技能成长和最多十六人合作。
best_for_en: Choose Valheim for procedural Viking survival; choose Enshrouded for a larger co-op group and action-RPG progression.
best_for_zh: 喜欢程序生成的维京生存可选《Valheim》；想要更大合作队伍和动作 RPG 成长可选《Enshrouded》。

why_similar_en: Both are rally games that ask the player to learn stages, control weight transfer and avoid mistakes over timed runs.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是拉力赛车游戏，玩家需要熟悉赛段、控制车辆重心并在计时比赛中避免失误。
key_differences_en: art of rally uses stylized environments and a pulled-back camera; DiRT Rally 2.0 uses detailed vehicle simulation, cockpit driving, online competition and optional VR.
key_differences_zh: 《art of rally》采用风格化环境和较远视角；《DiRT Rally 2.0》采用更细致的车辆模拟、座舱驾驶、在线竞赛和可选 VR。
best_for_en: Choose art of rally for a stylized and accessible rally format; choose DiRT Rally 2.0 for cockpit simulation and higher driving demands.
best_for_zh: 喜欢风格化、较易进入的拉力形式可选《art of rally》；想要座舱模拟和更高驾驶要求可选《DiRT Rally 2.0》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player 2D action roguelites with repeated runs, changing upgrades and fast platform combat.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人 2D 动作 Roguelite，通过重复挑战、变化的升级和快速平台战斗推进。
key_differences_en: Dead Cells mixes roguelite runs with metroidvania-style exploration and weapon drops; Skul changes combat roles by swapping collectible skulls.
key_differences_zh: 《Dead Cells》把 Roguelite 流程与类银河战士探索和武器掉落结合；《Skul》通过更换收集到的头骨切换战斗角色。
best_for_en: Choose Skul if changing character forms is the main appeal; choose Dead Cells for weapon variety and metroidvania-style routes.
best_for_zh: 如果最看重切换角色形态可选《Skul》；喜欢武器变化和类银河战士路线可选《Dead Cells》。

why_similar_en: Both are relaxed life-simulation games about gathering resources, crafting, decorating a home and building relationships.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是轻松的生活模拟游戏，核心包含采集资源、制作、布置家园和发展关系。
key_differences_en: Disney Dreamlight Valley centers on Disney and Pixar characters in a story-led neighborhood; Palia is a free-to-play online fantasy world with co-op and cross-platform multiplayer.
key_differences_zh: 《Disney Dreamlight Valley》围绕迪士尼和皮克斯角色及故事化社区展开；《Palia》是支持合作和跨平台联机的免费在线奇幻世界。
best_for_en: Choose Dreamlight Valley for Disney characters and guided stories; choose Palia for an online community and free entry.
best_for_zh: 喜欢迪士尼角色和引导式故事可选《Dreamlight Valley》；想进入在线社区并免费开始可选《Palia》。

why_similar_en: Both are pixel-art farming RPGs centered on growing a farm, forming relationships and improving a close community.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是像素风农场 RPG，围绕发展农场、培养关系和改善紧密社区展开。
key_differences_en: Fields of Mistria is a single-player fantasy with magic and ruins; Roots of Pacha uses a prehistoric setting, community discoveries and online co-op.
key_differences_zh: 《Fields of Mistria》是包含魔法和遗迹的单人幻想作品；《Roots of Pacha》采用史前设定、社区发现和在线合作。
best_for_en: Choose Roots of Pacha for co-op and prehistoric community building; choose Fields of Mistria for a solo magical town story.
best_for_zh: 想要合作和史前社区建设可选《Roots of Pacha》；偏好单人魔法小镇故事可选《Fields of Mistria》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player cinematic 2D adventures that combine environmental puzzles, stealth and story told largely through the world.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是电影化的单人 2D 冒险，把环境谜题、潜行和主要通过世界呈现的叙事结合。
key_differences_en: INSIDE follows a lone boy through an oppressive industrial project; Planet of Lana follows a girl and her creature companion through a machine invasion.
key_differences_zh: 《INSIDE》让孤身男孩穿过压抑的工业计划；《Planet of Lana》讲述女孩和生物伙伴面对机器入侵。
best_for_en: Choose INSIDE for darker isolation and industrial horror; choose Planet of Lana for a companion-led story with a more hopeful tone.
best_for_zh: 喜欢黑暗孤独和工业恐怖可选《INSIDE》；喜欢同伴同行和更有希望的基调可选《Planet of Lana》。

why_similar_en: Both are 3D town-life RPGs with gathering, crafting, relationships and cooperative play.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是 3D 城镇生活 RPG，包含采集、制作、关系培养和合作游玩。
key_differences_en: Coral Island centers on farming and restoring a tropical island and reef; My Time at Sandrock centers on workshop commissions, machines and rebuilding a desert town.
key_differences_zh: 《Coral Island》聚焦农场经营以及修复热带海岛和珊瑚礁；《My Time at Sandrock》聚焦工坊订单、机器制造和重建沙漠城镇。
best_for_en: Choose Coral Island for farming and ocean restoration; choose Sandrock for workshop production and desert-town rebuilding.
best_for_zh: 喜欢农场和海洋修复可选《Coral Island》；喜欢工坊生产和沙漠城镇重建可选《Sandrock》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player rhythm-action games where attacking in time with the soundtrack improves combat performance.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人节奏动作游戏，按照音乐节拍攻击会提升战斗表现。
key_differences_en: Hi-Fi RUSH uses third-person character-action combat in a colorful rock world; Metal: Hellsinger is a first-person shooter built around heavy metal and demons.
key_differences_zh: 《Hi-Fi RUSH》采用色彩鲜明的摇滚世界和第三人称角色动作战斗；《Metal: Hellsinger》是围绕重金属与恶魔展开的第一人称射击游戏。
best_for_en: Choose Hi-Fi RUSH for melee combos and platforming; choose Metal: Hellsinger for rhythm shooting and a metal soundtrack.
best_for_zh: 喜欢近战连招和平台动作可选《Hi-Fi RUSH》；喜欢节奏射击和重金属音乐可选《Metal: Hellsinger》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player card-based roguelikes where each run is shaped by drafting effects and combining them into a stronger deck engine.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人卡牌 Roguelike，每局通过获取效果并组合成更强的牌组引擎来推进。
key_differences_en: Inscryption combines creature-card battles with escape-room puzzles and psychological horror; Balatro builds scoring combinations from poker hands and Jokers.
key_differences_zh: 《Inscryption》把生物卡牌战斗、密室谜题和心理恐怖结合；《Balatro》围绕扑克牌型和 Joker 构建计分组合。
best_for_en: Choose Inscryption for story, puzzles and horror; choose Balatro for repeatable score-building runs without a horror narrative.
best_for_zh: 喜欢故事、谜题和恐怖氛围可选《Inscryption》；喜欢反复构建分数而不需要恐怖叙事可选《Balatro》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player open-world action RPGs that emphasize travel, combat preparation and player choice in how encounters are approached.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人开放世界动作 RPG，强调旅行、战斗准备以及玩家选择处理遭遇的方式。
key_differences_en: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II uses a grounded 15th-century European setting and follows Henry; Dragon's Dogma 2 is a fantasy RPG built around vocations and an AI-controlled Pawn party.
key_differences_zh: 《Kingdom Come: Deliverance II》采用写实的 15 世纪欧洲背景并围绕 Henry 展开；《Dragon's Dogma 2》是围绕职业和 AI Pawn 队伍设计的奇幻 RPG。
best_for_en: Choose Kingdom Come for historical role-playing; choose Dragon's Dogma 2 for fantasy combat and Pawn-based party play.
best_for_zh: 喜欢历史角色扮演可选《Kingdom Come》；喜欢奇幻战斗和 Pawn 队伍玩法可选《Dragon's Dogma 2》。

why_similar_en: Both are CD Projekt Red single-player open-world RPGs with authored quests, a defined protagonist and build-based combat progression.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是 CD Projekt Red 制作的单人开放世界 RPG，拥有作者化任务、固定主角和构筑驱动的战斗成长。
key_differences_en: The Witcher 3 follows monster hunter Geralt across a medieval fantasy continent; Cyberpunk 2077 follows V through the futuristic city of Night City with firearms and cyberware.
key_differences_zh: 《The Witcher 3》讲述猎魔人 Geralt 在中世纪奇幻大陆的旅程；《Cyberpunk 2077》讲述 V 在未来都市 Night City 使用枪械和义体行动。
best_for_en: Choose The Witcher 3 for medieval fantasy and monster hunting; choose Cyberpunk 2077 for a futuristic city and firearm-focused builds.
best_for_zh: 喜欢中世纪奇幻和猎魔可选《The Witcher 3》；喜欢未来都市和枪械构筑可选《Cyberpunk 2077》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player city-building strategy games about keeping a settlement alive during an environmental catastrophe.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人城市建设策略游戏，核心是在环境灾难中维持聚落生存。
key_differences_en: Against the Storm rebuilds fantasy settlements under apocalyptic rain with several species; Frostpunk manages humanity's last city in extreme cold and foregrounds social laws and moral choices.
key_differences_zh: 《Against the Storm》让多个种族在末日暴雨中重建幻想聚落；《Frostpunk》让玩家在极寒中管理人类最后的城市，并突出社会法律和道德选择。
best_for_en: Choose Against the Storm for repeated settlement-building runs; choose Frostpunk for one city's survival story and social decisions.
best_for_zh: 喜欢反复建设不同聚落可选《Against the Storm》；喜欢单座城市的生存故事和社会抉择可选《Frostpunk》。

why_similar_en: Both are VR rhythm games that turn upper-body movement into timed interaction with music and support solo and multiplayer play.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是 VR 节奏游戏，把上半身动作转化为与音乐同步的操作，并支持单人和多人游玩。
key_differences_en: Beat Saber focuses on slashing directional blocks and dodging obstacles; Synth Riders uses flowing hand targets and a dance-oriented movement style.
key_differences_zh: 《Beat Saber》聚焦按方向劈砍方块和闪避障碍；《Synth Riders》采用连续手部目标和更偏舞蹈的动作方式。
best_for_en: Choose Beat Saber for precise slashing patterns; choose Synth Riders for continuous dance-like movement.
best_for_zh: 喜欢精确劈砍谱面可选《Beat Saber》；喜欢连续舞蹈式动作可选《Synth Riders》。

why_similar_en: Both are construction sandboxes where players assemble functional machines from individual parts and test them in combat.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是建造沙盒，玩家需要用独立零件组装可运行机器，并在战斗中测试。
key_differences_en: Besiege focuses on medieval siege machines and physics challenges; From the Depths focuses on voxel vehicles, fleets and strategic warfare from ocean to space.
key_differences_zh: 《Besiege》聚焦中世纪攻城机器和物理挑战；《From the Depths》使用更大的零件集合建造体素载具、舰队，并进行从海洋到太空的战略战争。
best_for_en: Choose Besiege for compact physics puzzles and siege machines; choose From the Depths for detailed vehicle engineering and fleet strategy.
best_for_zh: 喜欢紧凑物理谜题和攻城机器可选《Besiege》；喜欢细致载具工程和舰队战略可选《From the Depths》。

why_similar_en: Both are competitive team-based tactical shooters where planning, communication and execution determine short objective rounds.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是竞技团队战术射击游戏，短回合目标战中，规划、沟通和执行决定胜负。
key_differences_en: Counter-Strike 2 centers on a shared weapon economy and consistent equipment rules; Rainbow Six Siege centers on operators, gadgets and planning attacks or defenses around the environment.
key_differences_zh: 《Counter-Strike 2》围绕共享的武器经济和稳定装备规则展开；《Rainbow Six Siege》围绕干员、装备以及利用环境规划攻防展开。
best_for_en: Choose CS2 for economy-driven gun rounds; choose Siege for operator gadgets and environment-led planning.
best_for_zh: 喜欢经济系统驱动的枪战回合可选《CS2》；喜欢干员装备和环境规划可选《Siege》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player 2D action roguelites with changing castle runs, permanent progression and boss-focused combat.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人 2D 动作 Roguelite，包含变化的城堡流程、永久成长和首领战。
key_differences_en: Dead Cells emphasizes fast weapon-based combat and branching metroidvania routes; Rogue Legacy 2 makes each new run an heir with a class and traits.
key_differences_zh: 《Dead Cells》强调快速武器战斗和分支类银河战士路线；《Rogue Legacy 2》让每次新流程都由拥有职业和特质的继承人开始。
best_for_en: Choose Dead Cells for faster weapon swapping and route exploration; choose Rogue Legacy 2 for generational progression and character traits.
best_for_zh: 喜欢更快的武器切换和路线探索可选《Dead Cells》；喜欢世代成长和角色特质可选《Rogue Legacy 2》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player farming and life-simulation games that combine relationships, town stories and witchcraft.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人农场生活模拟游戏，把关系培养、城镇故事和巫术结合。
key_differences_en: Fields of Mistria uses pixel art, character customization and combat in ancient ruins; Wylde Flowers follows the defined character Tara in a fully voiced 3D story with a coven.
key_differences_zh: 《Fields of Mistria》采用像素画面、角色自定义和古代遗迹战斗；《Wylde Flowers》以固定主角 Tara 展开全语音 3D 故事，并围绕女巫集会发展。
best_for_en: Choose Wylde Flowers for a voiced, character-led story; choose Fields of Mistria for pixel art, customization and adventure combat.
best_for_zh: 喜欢全语音、角色驱动故事可选《Wylde Flowers》；喜欢像素画面、自定义和冒险战斗可选《Fields of Mistria》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player, hand-drawn 2D action-platformers with interconnected worlds, difficult bosses and story revealed through exploration.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是手绘单人 2D 动作平台游戏，拥有互联世界、高难首领以及通过探索展开的故事。
key_differences_en: Hollow Knight centers on nail combat in a ruined insect kingdom; Nine Sols uses deflection-focused combat and an eastern-fantasy science-fiction setting.
key_differences_zh: 《Hollow Knight》围绕废墟昆虫王国中的骨钉战斗展开；《Nine Sols》采用偏重格挡反击的战斗和东方幻想科幻设定。
best_for_en: Choose Nine Sols for deflection-focused combat; choose Hollow Knight for its broader ruined-kingdom exploration and nail-based combat.
best_for_zh: 喜欢格挡反击战斗可选《Nine Sols》；喜欢更广的废墟王国探索和骨钉战斗可选《Hollow Knight》。

why_similar_en: Both are cooperative horror games where a team enters hostile locations, gathers resources or completes objectives and must coordinate to escape.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是合作恐怖游戏，队伍需要进入危险地点、收集资源或完成目标，并通过配合撤离。
key_differences_en: Lethal Company is an Early Access scavenging game about meeting a company quota on abandoned moons; GTFO is a structured hardcore shooter that combines stealth, limited resources and coordinated combat.
key_differences_zh: 《Lethal Company》是抢先体验中的废弃卫星搜刮游戏，目标是完成公司配额；《GTFO》是结构化硬核射击游戏，结合潜行、有限资源和协同战斗。
best_for_en: Choose Lethal Company for unpredictable scavenging sessions; choose GTFO for planned missions and demanding shooter teamwork.
best_for_zh: 喜欢不可预测的搜刮对局可选《Lethal Company》；喜欢计划明确、要求较高的射击协作可选《GTFO》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player life-simulation adventures about restoring a damaged place through gathering, crafting and helping a community.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是单人生活模拟冒险，通过采集、制作和帮助社区修复受损地点。
key_differences_en: My Time at Portia centers on workshop commissions, machines, farming and town relationships; Grow: Song of the Evertree centers on creating and nurturing small worlds to restore the Evertree.
key_differences_zh: 《My Time at Portia》聚焦工坊订单、机器、种植和城镇关系；《Grow: Song of the Evertree》聚焦创造并培育小世界来修复 Evertree。
best_for_en: Choose Portia for workshop production and commissions; choose Grow for world nurturing and ecosystem restoration.
best_for_zh: 喜欢工坊生产和订单可选《Portia》；喜欢培育世界和生态修复可选《Grow》。

why_similar_en: Both are single-player, nonlinear 2D action games with demanding combat, ability progression and repeated attempts after death.
why_similar_zh: 两者都是非线性的单人 2D 动作游戏，包含高要求战斗、能力成长和死亡后的重复尝试。
key_differences_en: Salt and Sanctuary adds extensive RPG equipment and local multiplayer in a cursed island setting; Moonscars is single-player and follows Grey Irma through a clay-and-ichor world.
key_differences_zh: 《Salt and Sanctuary》在诅咒岛屿中加入大量 RPG 装备和本地多人玩法；《Moonscars》是单人游戏，讲述 Grey Irma 在黏土与灵液世界中的旅程。
best_for_en: Choose Salt and Sanctuary for deeper equipment builds and local play; choose Moonscars for a focused single-player parry-and-ability journey.
best_for_zh: 喜欢更深装备构筑和本地游玩可选《Salt and Sanctuary》；喜欢专注单人格挡与能力成长可选《Moonscars》。
